the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

Hologic helps women around the world live healthier lives.

We develop innovative medical technologies that effectively detect, diagnose and treat health
conditions and raise the standard of care globally.

We know women face unique health challenges at every stage of life, and we are passionate about
being a force for good.

Hologic is propelled by the passion and courage of our people to make a difference and innovate in
all we do. We believe everyone should feel welcomed, valued and heard, because great ideas come from
a diversity of views and experiences. We are proud to create opportunities for those who want to
grow their careers while making the world a better, healthier place.

## Explore the latest from Labcorp

### REAL-WORLD DATA PLATFORM

#### AI‑powered real‑world data platform for Alzheimer's disease

Developed with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Datavant, Labcorp’s AI-powered platform delivers
longitudinal laboratory data at scale with advanced analytics to accelerate discovery, streamline
drug development, and improve patient outcomes.

[ Learn More ][211]
[Read Press Release][212]
[Mother and daughter embracing themselves with smiles on their faces]

### MyLabcorp mobile app

#### My results, trends, and more, all in MyLabcorp.

Staying on top of your health just got easier. MyLabcorp is our AI-powered app that helps explain
your Labcorp test results, tracks your trends over time, and lets you manage appointments and
billing, in one place.

[ Learn More ][213]
[Read Press Release][214]
[Patient using MyLabcorp application on their phone]

### Test Finder

#### Plain language, smarter support: AI that speaks clinician

Labcorp's AI-enhanced Test Finder, a first-of-its-kind conversational search tool, is now integrated
into EHRs using [Labcorp Diagnostic Assistant™][215] and available through EHR companion platform
[Labcorp Link™][216], enabling seamless and intuitive test search at the point of care. 

[ View Test Finder ][217]
[Read Press Release][218]

Genetic Insights

### Invitae joins Labcorp

Labcorp welcomes the Invitae team, scientific leaders and pioneers in the development and adoption
of genetic testing.

[ Learn More ][219]

Data Solutions

### Leading with Lab Data

Providers like Dr. Doron Schneider have the power to change lives. Our lab data has the answers to
empower them.

[ Learn More ][220]

Oncology

### Delivering insights that bring hope

Testing options like solid tissue biopsies and blood-based testing alternatives help clear the path
to better outcomes for patients. 

[ Learn More ][221]

Biopharma

### Scientifically rigorous, extensive in scale

Our global lab footprint, vast clinical data and scientific expertise help accelerate the drug
development process.

[ Learn More ][222]

### Stop wondering. Go test yourself.

Explore over 50 self-ordered lab tests and get answers about your health.

## Explore the latest from Labcorp

### REAL-WORLD DATA PLATFORM

#### AI‑powered real‑world data platform for Alzheimer's disease

Developed with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Datavant, Labcorp’s AI-powered platform delivers
longitudinal laboratory data at scale with advanced analytics to accelerate discovery, streamline
drug development, and improve patient outcomes.

[ Learn More ][211]
[Read Press Release][212]
[Mother and daughter embracing themselves with smiles on their faces]

### MyLabcorp mobile app

#### My results, trends, and more, all in MyLabcorp.

Staying on top of your health just got easier. MyLabcorp is our AI-powered app that helps explain
your Labcorp test results, tracks your trends over time, and lets you manage appointments and
billing, in one place.

[ Learn More ][213]
[Read Press Release][214]
[Patient using MyLabcorp application on their phone]

### Test Finder

#### Plain language, smarter support: AI that speaks clinician

Labcorp's AI-enhanced Test Finder, a first-of-its-kind conversational search tool, is now integrated
into EHRs using [Labcorp Diagnostic Assistant™][215] and available through EHR companion platform
[Labcorp Link™][216], enabling seamless and intuitive test search at the point of care. 

[ View Test Finder ][217]
[Read Press Release][218]

### Invitae joins Labcorp

Labcorp welcomes the Invitae team, scientific leaders and pioneers in the development and adoption
of genetic testing.

[ Learn More ][219]

### Leading with Lab Data

Providers like Dr. Doron Schneider have the power to change lives. Our lab data has the answers to
empower them.

[ Learn More ][220]

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]

  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

[Roche publishes its first quarter results for 2026][103]

Roche reports 7% (CER) sales for the full year results in 2025. Commenting on the results, CEO
Thomas Schinecker said: “2025 was a strong year for Roche, reflecting our continued focus on
operational and R&D excellence.”

positive change for patients, the people they love and the professionals who care for them. Discover
the highlights in our Annual Report.

  significant role in the development of risk factors for CVD and are increasingly a target of
  consideration for preventive cardiology interventions.

  healthcare settings, significantly impacting daily life. They range from mild illnesses to severe
  diseases such as pneumonia and meningitis.
  Medscape Features Slideshows, November 13, 2025

  complications, including abdominal catastrophes.
  November 13, 2025

# Welcome to EyeWiki

The Eye Encyclopedia written by Eye Physicians and Surgeons

EyeWiki is where ophthalmologists, other physicians, patients, and the public can learn about the
vast spectrum of eye disease, diagnosis, and treatment. Any qualified ophthalmologist or
ophthalmologist in training is [invited to contribute content to the wiki][16]. The work on this
site is a collaboration between the [American Academy of Ophthalmology][17] and [more than a dozen
societies][18].

Access EyeWiki on the [**AAO Ophthalmic Education app**][19].

[[2026 International Ophthalmologists Contest Winner]][20]

# Welcome to EyeWiki

The Eye Encyclopedia written by Eye Physicians and Surgeons

EyeWiki is where ophthalmologists, other physicians, patients, and the public can learn about the
vast spectrum of eye disease, diagnosis, and treatment. Any qualified ophthalmologist or
ophthalmologist in training is [invited to contribute content to the wiki][16]. The work on this
site is a collaboration between the [American Academy of Ophthalmology][17] and [more than a dozen
societies][18].

Access EyeWiki on the [**AAO Ophthalmic Education app**][19].

[[2026 International Ophthalmologists Contest Winner]][20]

### [2026 International Ophthalmologists Contest Winner][21]

* [Perineural Invasion and Perineural Spread in Ophthalmic Oncology][25]
* [Corectopia][26]
* [Body Dysmorphic Disorder in Oculofacial Surgery][27]

# Growjo

## The Fastest Growing Companies w/ Contacts & Emails

# Growjo tracks the fastest growing private companies and startups in the world. Using annual
# revenue, competitor/alternative analysis, “number of employees” growth, funding news, sales &
# financials, valuation increases and other growth triggers, we have created the list below of the
# Top 10,000 companies for the Spring of 2026. Because this list is focused on startups with
# traction, to qualify the company must have between 15 and 1,000 employees. In addition to the
# exportable list below, you can check our contact data for these companies that includes email
# addresses and direct phone numbers. Within the pages you will find quality alternatives to the
# said company as well. Or use our search bar to enrich or [find revenue for private companies][9].
# Growjo also segments lists based on Industry(e.g. [Fintech][10] [AI][11]) and Metro areas (e.g.
# [Silicon Valley][12]). Again this year as well as in 2025 we are seeing a LOT of Generative AI
# companies. the In addition, expect to see a lot of tech, clean energy and biotech companies as

# revenue, competitor/alternative analysis, “number of employees” growth, funding news, sales &

# traction, to qualify the company must have between 15 and 1,000 employees. In addition to the
# exportable list below, you can check our contact data for these companies that includes email
# addresses and direct phone numbers. Within the pages you will find quality alternatives to the
# said company as well. Or use our search bar to enrich or [find revenue for private companies][9].

insurance or not enough coverage for the testing they want or need. Additionally, millennials are
looking for a viable, affordable alternative to the Affordable Care Act (Obamacare). At
HealthLabs.com, we are able to get you the health and wellness testing you need quickly at an
affordable price.

rates.

* And confidentially receive your results in 1-3 days in your secure HealthLabs.com account

diagnoses and can point out any potentially problematic results that you can then take to your
doctor or general physician. Order the testing you need and receive your results quickly. We work
with major laboratories, like LabCorp and Quest Diagnostics, as well as smaller, local labs. These
labs are all CLIA-certified and often are the same labs your doctor uses!

in helping to make a diagnosis or helping to rule out various diagnoses. We have hundreds of lab
tests to choose. Some of our popular tests include:

* [STD Testing][88]

basic wellness done, HealthLabs.com's direct access testing can help you get answers to some of the
important health questions you have.

## Convenient & Affordable Online Lab Testing

There are many reasons why individuals order lab testing or blood work online. The most common
reasons why people use our services for lab tests online include having a high deductible, having no
insurance or not enough coverage for the testing they want or need. Additionally, millennials are
looking for a viable, affordable alternative to the Affordable Care Act (Obamacare). At
HealthLabs.com, we are able to get you the health and wellness testing you need quickly at an
affordable price.

HealthLabs.com offers an expansive collection of lab test categories and test types at discounted
rates.
* Simply order your blood or urine tests online
* Visit a [local lab][81] near you to give your blood work or urine sample for testing
* And confidentially receive your results in 1-3 days in your secure HealthLabs.com account

Your health is important! Our blood chemistry tests and [wellness tests][82] can help lead to
diagnoses and can point out any potentially problematic results that you can then take to your
doctor or general physician. Order the testing you need and receive your results quickly. We work
with major laboratories, like LabCorp and Quest Diagnostics, as well as smaller, local labs. These
labs are all CLIA-certified and often are the same labs your doctor uses!

Our online lab testing is great for monitoring conditions, disorders and diseases as well as aiding
in helping to make a diagnosis or helping to rule out various diagnoses. We have hundreds of lab
tests to choose. Some of our popular tests include:

Whether you need hormone testing, [food allergy testing][89], low-T or testosterone testing, or even
basic wellness done, HealthLabs.com's direct access testing can help you get answers to some of the
important health questions you have.

## As you support *society* through complex challenges, our Society supports *you*

We provide our members with research and educational opportunities. We help them stay up to date on
news and developments in the field. We advocate for better ID funding and evidence-based policies
across all levels of government.

[

### 13,000+ members

Find out more about IDSA membership
][100]
What We Focus On

## Key initiatives

Your impact is vast — so ours must be too. Here are our main area of focus:

[

#### Antimicrobial resistance

On the forefront of advancements with AMR
][101]
[

#### Clinical guidelines

Acting faster and smarter with the world’s leading expertise as our guide
][102]
[

#### Compensation

Advocating for the value of ID physicians to increase professional fulfillment and compensation
][103]
[

#### Health equity

Advancing health equity in infectious diseases
][104]
[

#### ID workforce

Empowering infectious diseases professionals
][105]

## Testimonial

### “The work that I do for adolescents and youth that are marginalized is everything to me. I’m
### going to fight for it.”

Michelle D. Collins-Ogle, MD
Discover the Benefits

## Membership *amplifies* your impact

With your IDSA membership, you get access to leading research, more professional development
opportunities and access to the world’s largest network of leading infectious diseases experts.

[Membership][106]

#### 2-for-1 membership in HIVMA

Your membership in IDSA automatically includes all the same access to our HIV Medicine Association.

#### Free journal subscriptions

Enjoy subscriptions to two of IDSA’s scholarly journals, *The Journal of Infectious Diseases* and
*Clinical Infectious Diseases*.

#### Growth opportunities

IDSA offers research awards to support young researchers and provides mentorship to attract top
talent to the field.

[Jal Medical provides infectious diseases rapid screen test kits for detecting diseases like HIV,

suitable for preliminary or emergency medical screening. The fertility rapid test kits section
comprises of ovulation test kit, menopause test kit, and pregnancy test kits. The ovulation test kit
helps in predicting the fertility cycle for female to either aid or avoid pregnancy. For normal
women, the Luteinizing Hormone or LH increases substantially in the middle of menstrual cycle. This
hormone is found in the urine, which is detected using the ovulation test kit. An Increase in the LH
expedites the ovulation process in which the egg is released periodically from normal fertile woman.
The kit consists of a cassette in which specimen is dropped. The capillary action carries this
specimen to migrate along the membrane and reaches the test zone. As the traces of LH in the
specimen reaches the test zone of the membrane, it results in the formation of a colored line that
denotes a positive result. Absence of colored line signifies negative result.]

Drug Of Abuse Rapid Screen Tests
[Jal Medical provides infectious diseases rapid screen test kits for detecting diseases like HIV,
Syphilis, Influenza, Hepatitis, Tuberculosis, Vibrio Cholerae, Malaria, Dengue, etc. These diseases
are highly infectious in nature and hence must be detected early so that the individuals are treated
easily and the disease is not transferred to others as well. HIV, for example, is a virus that
targets and alters the entire immune system of the humans. It is very important that it gets
detected at an early stage so that the virus causes less damage to the body. HIV stands for Human
immunodeficiency virus and if left untreated for a considerable period of time can lead to AIDS. HIV
has the tendency to target and infiltrate the white blood cells, which ultimately deters the body’s
capacity to combat other diseases. It is a lifelong infection and receiving treatment and effective
management goes a long way in preventing HIV from reaching a severe level. The risk of the virus
getting passed on to other individuals in also reduced.]
Infectious Diseases Rapid Screen Tests
[Jal Medical offers product line such as iCare fertility rapid test kits. A rapid diagnostic test is
a quick and easy diagnostic test to be performed with the help of rapid test kits. It is mostly
suitable for preliminary or emergency medical screening. The fertility rapid test kits section
comprises of ovulation test kit, menopause test kit, and pregnancy test kits. The ovulation test kit
helps in predicting the fertility cycle for female to either aid or avoid pregnancy. For normal
women, the Luteinizing Hormone or LH increases substantially in the middle of menstrual cycle. This
hormone is found in the urine, which is detected using the ovulation test kit. An Increase in the LH
expedites the ovulation process in which the egg is released periodically from normal fertile woman.
The kit consists of a cassette in which specimen is dropped. The capillary action carries this
specimen to migrate along the membrane and reaches the test zone. As the traces of LH in the
specimen reaches the test zone of the membrane, it results in the formation of a colored line that
denotes a positive result. Absence of colored line signifies negative result.]
